title: Hypothesis-Driven Autonomous Materials Synthesis with Multimodal LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.18598v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Self-driving laboratories can explore synthesis conditions autonomously, but their decision-making layer is typically a black-box optimizer, and the output is a set of optimized samples, with the measurements reduced to predefined scalar objectives and the reasons behind success left unarticulated. Here we present SynAgent, a framework in which large language model agents operate an automated experimental system and maintain an explicit, revisable understanding of the synthesis process as the campaign's primary output. Starting with no predefined analysis pipeline, SynAgent adaptively generates analysis skills for newly acquired data and evolves this understanding through multimodal reasoning over experimental data such as X-ray diffraction patterns and electron micrographs. translated_title: 基于多模态大语言模型智能体的假设驱动自主材料合成
translated_abstract: 自动驾驶实验室能够自主探索合成条件，但其决策层通常是黑盒优化器，输出仅为一批优化后的样品，测量结果被简化为预定义的标量目标，而成功背后的原因未被明确阐述。本文提出SynAgent框架，其中大语言模型智能体操作自动化实验系统，并将对合成过程的显式、可修订的理解作为实验活动的主要输出加以维护。SynAgent从没有预定义分析流程的状态出发，能够针对新获取的数据自适应地生成分析技能，并通过对X射线衍射图谱和电子显微照片等实验数据进行多模态推理来不断演化这一理解。该演化过程由“验证-证伪”方案引导，智能体会有意通过测试预测会失败的条件来主动挑战自身假设……
tldr: 提出SynAgent框架，利用多模态大语言模型智能体自主开展材料合成实验，通过“验证-证伪”机制形成并持续修正对合成过程的显式科学理解，突破了传统自动驾驶实验室黑盒优化的局限。
en_tdlr: SynAgent employs multimodal LLM agents to autonomously conduct materials synthesis, evolving explicit and revisable scientific understanding of the synthesis process through a verify-falsify scheme, moving beyond black-box optimization in self-driving laboratories.
